items.description: Through festivals, exhibitions and traditional performances, the government is seeking to create greater visibility for Kenya's different communities while highlighting the economic opportunities that can emerge from cultural tourism. The post PS Ummi Bashir joins Somali cultural dance during Wajir visit appeared first on KBC Digital .
items.imageCaption: Ummi Bashir, PS Culture and Heritage, joins Somali dance troupe/KNA | Somali dance troupe/KNA
items.author: Nzula Nzyoka
items.excerpt: Welcome to the official Kenya Broadcasting Corporation (KBC) News YouTube channel. Principal Secretary for Culture, the Arts and Heritage, Ummi Bashir, showed off her dance moves by joining a traditional Somali dance during a cultural exhibition at Wagberi Primary School in Wajir County on Saturday, November 21. The PS joined local performers during the exhibition, where traditional dances and cultural displays showcased the Somali community’s customs and heritage.
